product.name: Warm desk lamp
product.description: The lamp throws a warm pool on a desk.

blocks.text: The first parcel is $11.66. The single parcel choice is the other line, and it is not the one marked.
The host is the shop you opened. No packing line is added. Wick trim is not ticked. Warm desk lamp is a single item unless the repeat stays marked.
Ordinary ground carrier cost is already inside the tag.
The later bill is eighty dollars and forty six cents every quarter.

trick.evidence_text: The marked line repeats after the first parcel at eighty dollars and forty six cents every quarter.
trick.instruction: Pick the single parcel line and turn the repeat off before you pay.
